    sheet per team and write the differences down before anyone merges them &mdash; the variation is the finding, not noise.
    Count the client row from CI workflow files and endpoint data, not from memory: a CI runner invoking the harness on every pull request is a client.
    Chapter note: the diagram draws a fifth node, Tools, that the prose does not count as a part; it is recorded under the harness at field 12.

  <div class="ws-instruction">
